Nor’easter 40-50 MPH Wind And Rain Storm Hitting NYC This Weekend, Roosevelt Island Saturday Farmers Market Open And Moving Under The Protection Of Motorgate Helix

by Roosevelt Islander September 25, 2026 7:56 pmSeptember 25, 2026 8:01 pm

Due to the Nor’easter wind and rain storm coming this weekend, tomorrow’s Saturday Roosevelt Island Farmers Market will be located under the protection of the Helix at Motorgate Plaza for your fresh fruits, vegetables and more.

iDig2Learn reports:

Sign up for our free email newsletter

Roosevelt Islander is your source for daily accurate and timely news, information and events in our unique community.

And @hakicompost will have green bins available to collect @rooseveltislandny neighbors food scraps for the @bigreuse community compost program.

According to the Roosevelt Island Operating Corp (RIOC):

The City has issued a Travel Advisory for Friday, September 25 through Sunday, September 27 due to a nor’easter expected to bring rain, strong winds and coastal flooding to New York City.

Winds are expected to increase Friday afternoon and evening, with gusts potentially reaching 40–50 mph. Rain is expected through Sunday, with approximately 2–3 inches possible. Coastal flooding is also possible around the Friday evening and Saturday morning high tides.

If you’re traveling to or from Roosevelt Island this weekend, please allow extra time for your trip and check transit service before leaving. To receive alerts from NotifyNYC, visit the link here. 

Conditions are expected to improve Saturday night into Sunday as the storm moves farther offshore. Please stay safe and plan ahead.

Thank you.

-Team RIOC
